description: Non-destructive Tome of Magic Class & Feat V3 Lego-block patch: upgrades cls-binder, replaces cls-shadowcaster-not-implemented & cls-truenamer-not-implemented, adds 5 Shadow Magic PrCs + 5 Truename Magic PrCs, and adds 17 Shadow/Metashadow + 20 Truename/Recitation feats.

classes.name: Binder

1.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
1.summary: Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor, but not shields.

1.name: Soul Binding (1 vestige, max 1st-level)
1.summary: Draw a vestige's seal (1 min) and summon it (full-round) to make a binding check (1d20 + EBL + Cha mod) for a 24-hour pact. Save DC = 10 + 1/2 EBL + Cha mod.

2.name: Pact Augmentation (1 ability)
2.summary: While bound to at least one vestige, select one stacking pact augmentation: +5 hp, energy resistance 5 (acid/cold/electricity/fire/sonic), +1 insight to saves, DR 1/-, +1 insight to AC, +1 insight to attack, +1 insight to damage, or +2 insight to initiative.

2.name: Suppress Sign
2.summary: When making a good pact, suppress or reveal the vestige's physical sign at will as a swift action.

3.name: Maximum Vestige Level 2nd
3.summary: Effective binder level allows contacting up to 2nd-level vestiges.

4.name: Bonus Feat
4.summary: Gain a bonus feat from the binder list (Armor Proficiency medium/heavy, Diligent, Investigator, Martial Weapon Proficiency, Negotiator, Persuasive, Shield Proficiency, or any Pact Magic feat); must meet prerequisites.

5.name: Pact Augmentation (2 abilities)
5.summary: Select up to 2 Pact Augmentation abilities while bound.

6.name: Soul Guardian (Immune to Fear)
6.summary: Gain immunity to fear effects while bound to a vestige.

8.name: Soul Binding (2 vestiges)
8.summary: Can maintain pacts with up to 2 vestiges simultaneously.

9.name: Soul Guardian (Slippery Mind)
9.summary: While bound, gain slippery mind: 1 round after failing a save against an enchantment, attempt a second save at the same DC.

10.name: Pact Augmentation (3 abilities)
10.summary: Select up to 3 Pact Augmentation abilities while bound.

10.name: Maximum Vestige Level 5th
10.summary: May bind up to 5th-level vestiges.

11.name: Bonus Feat
11.summary: Gain a bonus feat from the binder bonus feat list.

13.name: Soul Guardian (Immune to Energy Drain and Negative Levels)
13.summary: Gain immunity to energy drain and negative levels while bound to a vestige.

14.name: Soul Binding (3 vestiges)
14.summary: Can maintain pacts with up to 3 vestiges simultaneously.

16.name: Pact Augmentation (4 abilities)
16.summary: Select up to 4 Pact Augmentation abilities while bound.

18.name: Bonus Feat
18.summary: Gain a bonus feat from the binder bonus feat list.

19.name: Soul Guardian (Mind Blank)
19.summary: While bound to a vestige, gain immunity to all mind-affecting spells and abilities.

20.name: Pact Augmentation (5 abilities)
20.summary: Select up to 5 Pact Augmentation abilities while bound.

20.name: Soul Binding (4 vestiges)
20.summary: Can maintain pacts with up to 4 vestiges simultaneously.

effects.text: Soul Binding (Su): Contact and bind vestiges using Effective Binder Level (class level + PrC bonuses). Binding check = 1d20 + EBL + Cha mod (rushed full-round check at -10 penalty). Vestige save DC = 10 + 1/2 EBL + Cha mod.

branches.condText: Class level 6+ & bound to a vestige
Class level 13+ & bound to a vestige

kids.what: Energy drain and negative levels (Soul Guardian 13th)

branches.condText: Class level 19+ & bound to a vestige

kids.what: All mind-affecting spells and abilities (Soul Guardian 19th)

classes.shortDescription: Base Pact Magic class (ToM pp. 9-15); binds up to 4 vestiges (1st-8th level) for 24-hour supernatural powers, Pact Augmentations, and Soul Guardian immunities.
classes.description: Binder (Tome of Magic pp. 9-15, Table 1-1). Binds vestiges via drawn seals and 1d20 + EBL + Cha binding checks. Proficient with simple weapons and light armor (no shields). Gains Suppress Sign (2nd), Pact Augmentation (2nd/5th/10th/16th/20th), Soul Guardian (6th fear immunity, 9th slippery mind, 13th energy drain/negative level immunity, 19th mind-affecting immunity), and bonus feats at 4th, 11th, and 18th.

classes.name: Shadowcaster

1.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
1.summary: Proficient with all simple weapons. Not proficient with any type of armor or shield; armor causes arcane spell failure for mysteries cast as spells.

1.name: Fundamentals of Shadow
1.summary: Begin play knowing 3 fundamentals usable 3/day each as supernatural abilities (DC 10 + Cha mod).

1.name: Mysteries and Paths (Apprentice Mysteries)
1.summary: Learn 1 mystery per class level (must learn all prior mysteries in a path and at least 2 mysteries of the previous level within a category). Requires Int >= 10 + mystery level; Save DC = 10 + mystery level + Cha mod. Levels 1-6 cast Apprentice mysteries as arcane spells (1/day, somatic, ASF).

2.name: Bonus Feat (Path-Based)
2.summary: Gain bonus feats equal to half total mystery paths accessed (rounded down; fundamentals excluded). Select from Metamagic feats, Metashadow feats, Favored Mystery, Greater Path Focus, Nocturnal Caster, Path Focus, or Shadow Vision; must meet prerequisites.

3.name: Umbral Sight (Darkvision 30 ft.)
3.summary: Gain darkvision out to 30 feet (or +30 feet to existing darkvision).

5.name: Sustaining Shadow (Eat 1 Meal/Week)
5.summary: Need eat only a single meal per week to maintain health.

7.name: Apprentice Mysteries (Spell-Like)
7.summary: Apprentice mysteries (1st-3rd) now function as spell-like abilities (2/day, no somatic components or ASF).

7.name: Initiate Mysteries
7.summary: Gain access to 4th-6th level Initiate mysteries, cast as arcane spells (1/day).

10.name: Sustaining Shadow (Sleep 1 Hour/Day)
10.summary: Need only 1 hour of sleep per night (still must rest 8 hours to regain daily mystery uses).

11.name: Umbral Sight (See in Darkness 60 ft.)
11.summary: See perfectly in complete darkness, even magical darkness, out to 60 feet.

13.name: Apprentice Mysteries (Supernatural)
13.summary: Apprentice mysteries (1st-3rd) now function as supernatural abilities (3/day, no SR, no concentration/AoO).

13.name: Initiate Mysteries (Spell-Like)
13.summary: Initiate mysteries (4th-6th) now function as spell-like abilities (2/day, no somatic components).

13.name: Master Mysteries
13.summary: Gain access to 7th-9th level Master mysteries, cast as arcane spells (1/day).

14.name: Unlimited Uses of Fundamentals
14.summary: Use all known fundamentals an unlimited number of times per day.

15.name: Sustaining Shadow (Immune to Poison and Disease)
15.summary: Gain immunity to nonmagical diseases and poisons.

20.name: Sustaining Shadow (No Need to Breathe, Eat, or Sleep)
20.summary: No longer need to breathe, eat, or sleep.

kids.what: Darkvision 30 ft. (+30 ft. if already possessed)
See in Darkness 60 ft. (including magical darkness)

classes.shortDescription: Base Shadow Magic class (ToM pp. 111-116); learns 20 mysteries & up to 8 fundamentals that evolve from arcane spells to spell-like and supernatural abilities.
classes.description: Shadowcaster (Tome of Magic pp. 111-116, Tables 2-1 & 2-2). Uses Fundamentals of Shadow (3 at 1st + 1 per 4 levels, unlimited at 14th) and 1 Mystery per level across Apprentice (1st-3rd), Initiate (4th-6th at 7th), and Master (7th-9th at 13th) paths. Min Int = 10 + mystery level; DC = 10 + mystery level + Cha mod. Gains path-based bonus feats (floor(paths/2) starting at 2nd), Umbral Sight (3rd/11th), and Sustaining Shadow (5th/10th/15th/20th).

classes.name: Truenamer

1.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
1.summary: Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor, but not shields.

1.name: Known Personal Truename
1.summary: Know your own personal truename; speaking it requires Truespeak DC 15 + 2*HD + 2, with a +4 bonus on the check.

1.name: Utterances (Lexicon of the Evolving Mind)
1.summary: Speak creature-targeted utterances (normal or reversed) as standard-action spell-like abilities with verbal components requiring Truespeak DC 15 + 2*CR (+2 per Law of Resistance use/day). Save DC = 10 + 1/2 truenamer level + Cha mod.

2.name: Knowledge Focus (+3)
2.summary: Gain a permanent +3 bonus on any one Knowledge skill of your choice (stacks if reselected).

4.name: Lexicon of the Crafted Tool (1st-level)
4.summary: Gain access to 1st-level utterances of the Lexicon of the Crafted Tool (object-targeted utterances).

6.name: Truename Research
6.summary: Gain Truename Research as a bonus feat.

7.name: Knowledge Focus (+3)
7.summary: Gain an additional permanent +3 bonus on a Knowledge skill.

8.name: Bonus Recitation Feat
8.summary: Gain a bonus Recitation feat (must meet prerequisites).

8.name: Lexicon of the Perfected Map (1st-level)
8.summary: Gain access to 1st-level utterances of the Lexicon of the Perfected Map (area-targeted utterances).

9.name: See the Named (1/day)
9.summary: Once per day, speak a creature's personal truename (normal Truespeak check) to view it for 1 round as scrying (no save, no focus required).

10.name: Knowledge Focus (+3)
10.summary: Gain an additional permanent +3 bonus on a Knowledge skill.

13.name: Sending (3/day)
13.summary: Three times per day, succeed on a DC 15 + 2*CR Truespeak check on a creature's personal truename to send a message as sending (CL = truenamer level).

14.name: Knowledge Focus (+3)
14.summary: Gain an additional permanent +3 bonus on a Knowledge skill.

15.name: Bonus Recitation Feat
15.summary: Gain a second bonus Recitation feat (must meet prerequisites).

17.name: Speak Unto the Masses
17.summary: Affect multiple creatures of the same type within 30 ft. of each other with one utterance; base DC uses highest CR/HD + 2 per additional target.

20.name: Say My Name and I Am There
20.summary: Develop a true nickname; anyone speaking it (no check needed) allows you to appear at their location as word of recall (optional).

effects.text: Known Personal Truename: DC 15 + 2*HD + 2, +4 competence/personal bonus when speaking your own personal truename. Utterance save DC = 10 + 1/2 truenamer level + Cha mod.

classes.shortDescription: Base Truename Magic class (ToM pp. 198-203); reshapes creatures, objects, and terrain via Truespeak skill checks across three Lexicons plus Recitation feats.
classes.description: Truenamer (Tome of Magic pp. 198-203, Tables 3-2 & 3-3). Gains 20 Evolving Mind (1st-6th), 5 Crafted Tool (1st-5th), and 4 Perfected Map (1st-4th) utterances. Save DC = 10 + 1/2 truenamer level + Cha mod. Gains Knowledge Focus (+3 at 2nd/7th/10th/14th), Truename Research (6th), Bonus Recitation feats (8th/15th), See the Named (9th), Sending (13th), Speak Unto the Masses (17th), and Say My Name and I Am There (20th).

classes.name: Child of Night

prerequisites.text: Skills: Knowledge (arcana) 8 ranks, Knowledge (the planes) 8 ranks
Shadowcasting/Spellcasting: Ability to cast mysteries or spells with the darkness descriptor or shadow subschool
Special: Must have visited the Plane of Shadow

1.name: Cloak of Shadows (+Level Hide)
1.summary: Gain a bonus equal to Child of Night class level on Hide checks.

1.name: Cold Resistance 5
1.summary: Gain cold resistance 5.

2.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
2.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day, caster level, and known mysteries/spells.

2.name: Sustaining Shadow (Eat 1 Meal/Week)
2.summary: Gain next Sustaining Shadow tier (1 meal/week, or auto-advance if already possessed).

3.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
3.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

3.name: Dancing Shadows (1/day)
3.summary: Use dancing shadows mystery 1/day as a supernatural ability (CL = Child of Night + other mystery-casting levels).

4.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
4.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

4.name: Cloak of Shadows (Blur 1/day)
4.summary: Swift action: gain blur for class level minutes, 1/day.

5.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
5.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

6.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
6.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

7.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
7.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

8.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
8.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

8.name: Cloak of Shadows (Blur Continuous)
8.summary: Your form is permanently hazy, granting a continuous blur effect.

9.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
9.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

10.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
10.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

10.name: Cloak of Shadows (Displacement 2/day)
10.summary: Swift action: gain displacement for 10 rounds, 2/day.

10.name: Night Form
10.summary: Become incorporeal (with incorporeal subtype and 40 ft. perfect fly speed) for 1 minute/day.

effects.condition: Child of Night class level (Cloak of Shadows)

classes.shortDescription: Shadow Magic PrC (ToM pp. 117-119, Table 2-3); 9/10 casting progression, cold resistance, continuous blur, Hide bonus, and incorporeal Night Form.
classes.description: Child of Night (Tome of Magic pp. 117-119). Entry: Knowledge (arcana) 8 ranks, Knowledge (the planes) 8 ranks, able to cast mysteries or spells with darkness descriptor/shadow subschool, visited the Plane of Shadow. 9/10 casting advancement (levels 2-10).

classes.name: Master of Shadow

1.name: Shadow Servant
1.summary: Your shadow familiar transforms permanently into a Medium shadow elemental companion (max distance 30 ft + 10 ft/level; 24 hr resummon if slain). Gains bonus HD, Dex adjustments, Size Increase to Large at 3rd, Deliver Touch Spells at 5th.

1.name: Master's Bidding (Standard Action)
1.summary: As a standard action, grant your shadow servant 1 special bidding ability for 1 round: Interact with Corporeal, Fast Healing 1 (2nd), Extra Attack (2nd), Cold Damage +1d8 (4th), Reach +5 ft (6th), DR 5/- (8th), or Speed +20 ft (10th).

2.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
2.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

2.name: Resistance to Cold 5
2.summary: You gain cold resistance 5; your shadow servant gains cold resistance 10.

3.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
3.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level (shadow servant grows to Large).

4.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
4.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

5.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
5.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

5.name: Master's Bidding (Move Action)
5.summary: Granting a Master's Bidding ability becomes a move action (can spend two move actions for two different abilities).

6.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
6.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

6.name: Resistance to Cold 20
6.summary: Cold resistance increases to 20 (both you and your shadow servant).

7.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
7.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

8.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
8.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

9.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
9.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

10.name: +1 Level of Existing Casting Class
10.summary: Advance mysteries/spells per day and caster level.

10.name: Immunity to Cold
10.summary: Gain immunity to cold (both you and your shadow servant).

10.name: Master's Bidding (Swift Action)
10.summary: Granting a Master's Bidding ability becomes a swift action.

10.name: Rapid Shadow
10.summary: Summon a replacement shadow servant in 10 minutes instead of 24 hours if slain.

effects.text: Shadow Servant (Su): Upgrades shadow familiar to Shadow Elemental companion (+1/+3/+5/+7/+9 Bonus HD and +1/+3/+5/+7/+9 Dex adj at 2nd/4th/6th/8th/10th; Large at 3rd).

classes.shortDescription: Shadow Magic PrC (ToM pp. 121-123, Table 2-4); 9/10 casting, upgrades shadow familiar into an evolving Large shadow elemental companion.
classes.description: Master of Shadow (Tome of Magic pp. 121-123). Entry: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Knowledge (the planes) 8 ranks, Shadow Familiar feat, Caster level 5th. 9/10 casting advancement (levels 2-10).

classes.name: Noctumancer

prerequisites.text: Spellcasting: Able to cast 2nd-level arcane spells

1.name: +1 Mystery-Using / +1 Arcane Spellcasting Class
1.summary: Advance both mystery-using and arcane spellcasting classes simultaneously.

1.name: Capture Magic's Shadow
1.summary: When successfully dispelling a foe's mystery or spell, add half its level (min 1) to the CL of the next mystery/spell you cast within 1 round.

2.name: Innate Counterspell (1/day)
2.summary: Counter a spell or mystery as an immediate action by expending an equal or higher-level spell slot or mystery use.

6.name: Eldritch Disruption (3/day)
6.summary: Standard action within 60 ft.: Will save (DC 10 + class level + Cha mod) or target takes -4 penalty to CL on mysteries/spells for 1 minute.

7.name: Innate Counterspell (Essence Retention)
7.summary: Successfully countering with Innate Counterspell grants an extra mystery use or spell slot of half the countered level (min 1).

10.name: +1 Mystery-Using / +1 Arcane Spellcasting Class
10.summary: Dual casting advancement.

10.name: Eldritch Vortex (1/day)
10.summary: 20-ft.-radius burst around self for 1 minute: all other creatures take -4 CL on mysteries, spells, and SLAs.

10.name: Shadow's Persistence
10.summary: Gain 1 minute immunity to any mystery or spell you capture or counter via Capture Magic's Shadow or Innate Counterspell.

effects.text: Dual Progression: Each Noctumancer level advances +1 existing mystery-using class AND +1 existing arcane spellcasting class.

classes.shortDescription: Dual-progression Shadow/Arcane PrC (ToM pp. 125-127, Table 2-5); 10/10 mystery + arcane casting, immediate-action counterspelling, and CL disruption.
classes.description: Noctumancer (Tome of Magic pp. 125-127). Entry: Knowledge (arcana) 6 ranks, Spellcraft 6 ranks, able to cast 2nd-level mysteries, able to cast 2nd-level arcane spells. 10/10 dual casting progression.

classes.name: Shadowblade

prerequisites.text: Special: Must have been exposed to shadow (Plane of Shadow, darkness mystery/spell, or shadow/dark creature)

1.name: Unseen Weapon (Unerring Strike)
1.summary: Standard action to shroud melee weapon in shadow; activate Unseen Weapon 1/day/class level as swift action. Unerring Strike: next melee attack ignores concealment/total concealment miss chance.

2.name: Shadow and Stealth
2.summary: Gain a circumstance bonus equal to half class level (round down) on Hide and Move Silently checks.

2.name: Sudden Strike +1d6
2.summary: Deal +1d6 damage when target is denied Dex bonus to AC (stacks with sneak attack).

3.name: Shadow Vision
3.summary: See clearly in shadowy illumination (up to 40 ft from torch, doubled with low-light vision).

3.name: Unseen Weapon (Unexpected Strike)
3.summary: Opponent is denied Dexterity bonus to AC against your next melee attack.

5.name: Unseen Weapon (Ephemeral Weapon)
5.summary: Next melee attack deals +2d6 bonus damage (stacks with sudden strike and sneak attack).

7.name: See in Darkness
7.summary: See perfectly in darkness of any kind, even deeper darkness.

7.name: Unseen Weapon (Shadowy Strike)
7.summary: Next melee attack resolves as a melee touch attack, ignoring armor and natural armor.

9.name: Unseen Weapon (Far Shadow)
9.summary: Melee reach increases by 10 feet for 1 round.

10.name: Sudden Strike +5d6
10.summary: Sudden strike increases to +5d6.

10.name: Unseen Weapon (Free Action)
10.summary: Activate Unseen Weapon abilities as a free action (still limited to 1/day per class level).

classes.shortDescription: Martial Shadow Magic PrC (ToM pp. 129-131, Table 2-6); Sudden Strike +5d6, Unseen Weapon touch/reach/no-Dex strikes, and See in Darkness.
classes.description: Shadowblade (Tome of Magic pp. 129-131). Entry: BAB +5, Bluff 5 ranks, Hide 5 ranks, Move Silently 5 ranks, Blind-Fight feat, prior exposure to shadow (Plane of Shadow, darkness spell/mystery, or shadow/dark creature).

classes.name: Shadowsmith

prerequisites.text: Skill: Craft (armorsmithing, blacksmithing, or weaponsmithing) 5 ranks
Special: Must have been exposed to shadow

1.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
1.summary: Proficient with simple and martial weapons, light armor, and shields (except tower shields).

1.name: Mysteries Known (1st Mystery)
1.summary: Cast 1 Apprentice mystery 1/day as arcane spell (min Int 10 + lvl; DC 10 + lvl + Cha).

1.name: Touch of Shadow
1.summary: Class level/day for 1 min/level: +class level on Climb checks and cannot be tracked.

2.name: Shroud of Shadow
2.summary: Class level/day for 1 min/level: +class level bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.

3.name: Shadow Craft (Basic)
3.summary: 1/2 class level/day (standard action): conjure non-mechanical tools/weapons/items up to 2*level lb (1 or 2 items) lasting 1 hr/level.

4.name: Armor of Shadow +2
4.summary: 1/2 class level/day (standard action): +2 deflection bonus to AC for 10 min/level.

5.name: Widen Shroud
5.summary: Extend Touch of Shadow to 1/2 class level allies within 10 ft. (uses 1 daily use of Touch of Shadow).

6.name: Shadow Craft (Enchanted)
6.summary: Full-round action + Craft DC 20+bonus: imbue shadow-crafted weapons/shields with total enhancement bonus = class level - 5.

7.name: Armor of Shadow +4
7.summary: Armor of Shadow deflection bonus increases to +4.

8.name: Shadow Craft (Armor)
8.summary: Use Shadow Craft to create light armor for yourself (with automatic improved shadow special ability and optional enhancement bonus).

9.name: Shadow Craft (Quickened)
9.summary: Conjure enchanted items as a standard action, nonmagical items as a swift action.

10.name: Shadow Craft (Shadow Striking)
10.summary: Apply the shadow striking property (ToM p.155) to a magic weapon created with Shadow Craft.

10.name: Armor of Shadow (Quickened)
10.summary: Activate Armor of Shadow (+4 deflection AC) as a swift action.

effects.text: Shadow Craft (Su): Creates weapons, shields, tools, and (at 8th) light armor from shadow; enhancement budget = class level - 5 starting at 6th.

classes.shortDescription: Full-BAB Martial Shadow Crafter PrC (ToM pp. 132-134, Table 2-7); 6+Int skills, enhanced shadow weapons/armor, deflection AC, and 3 Apprentice mysteries.
classes.description: Shadowsmith (Tome of Magic pp. 132-134). Entry: BAB +5, Craft (armorsmithing, blacksmithing, or weaponsmithing) 5 ranks, Knowledge (arcana) 3 ranks, Knowledge (the planes) 3 ranks, exposed to shadow.

classes.name: Acolyte of the Ego

prerequisites.text: Languages: Must speak at least four languages

1.name: Known Personal Truename
1.summary: Know your personal truename (DC 15 + 2*HD + 2, +4 bonus on check).

2.name: Morphic Cadence (1st)
2.summary: Standard action + personal truename Truespeak check (Law of Resistance +2/use): activate 1st morphic cadence (Distant Step, Frightful Mind, Iron Skin DR 2/magic +2/cadence, Living Fortress 20%/cadence fort, Lost Wound fast healing, Lucky Fool luck saves, Mighty Bull +Int Str, Prowling Tiger +Int Dex, Secret Mask disguise self, Swallowed Spell SR 15+2/cadence, Thunder Drake 2d6/cadence sonic cone, Ursine Heart +Int Con).

3.name: Resonant Voice
3.summary: Increase personal truename Truespeak DC by +5 to treat class level as +3 higher for morphic cadence effect and duration.

4.name: Morphic Cadence (2nd)
4.summary: Learn a 2nd morphic cadence; all known cadences scale.

5.name: Cadence Mastery
5.summary: Activate multiple morphic cadences in a single personal truename check (+5 DC per additional cadence).

7.name: Alter Personal Truename (-4)
7.summary: Others attempting to speak your personal truename take a -4 penalty on their Truespeak check.

7.name: Recitation Feat
7.summary: Gain a Recitation feat as a bonus feat (must meet prerequisites).

9.name: Alter Personal Truename (-8)
9.summary: Penalty to others speaking your personal truename increases to -8.

10.name: Morphic Cadence (5th)
10.summary: Learn a 5th morphic cadence.

effects.text: Morphic Cadences (Sp): Standard action, DC 15 + 2*HD + 2 (+2/day Law of Resistance, +4 personal truename bonus). Scales with total morphic cadences known (max 5).

classes.shortDescription: Full-BAB Truename Magic PrC (ToM pp. 204-206, Table 3-4); buffs self via Morphic Cadences on personal truename.
classes.description: Acolyte of the Ego (Tome of Magic pp. 204-206). Entry: Type Humanoid, Truespeak 9 ranks, must speak at least four languages. Grants 5 Morphic Cadences (2nd/4th/6th/8th/10th), Resonant Voice (3rd), Cadence Mastery (5th), Alter Personal Truename (7th/9th), and bonus Recitation feat (7th).

classes.name: Bereft

prerequisites.text: Alignment: Any neutral (LN, N, CN, NG, NE)
Languages: Must speak at least three languages
Special: Subject of ritual of renaming spell (3,700 gp)

1.name: Obscure Personal Truename
1.summary: Gain Obscure Personal Truename as a bonus feat upon completing the ritual of renaming.

1.name: Syllable of Detachment
1.summary: 60 ft., Truespeak check (Law of Resistance +2/use), CL = character level (2nd-lvl equiv): target takes -2 penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks for class level rounds.

2.name: Syllable of Affliction
2.summary: 60 ft., Truespeak check + Will negates (DC 10 + class level + Cha mod, 4th-lvl equiv): permanently/duration remove sight, hearing, smell, or touch (-2 Climb/Disable Device/Escape Artist/Jump/Open Lock/Search/Tumble/Use Rope) for class level rounds.

3.name: Syllable of Exile
3.summary: 60 ft., Truespeak check (6th-lvl equiv): functions as maze for 1 round (swift action Int check to escape on target's turn).

4.name: Syllable of Dissolution
4.summary: 60 ft., Truespeak check (7th-lvl equiv): target takes 8d6 damage with no save.

5.name: Syllable of Enervation
5.summary: 60 ft., Truespeak check (8th-lvl equiv): target gains 2 negative levels (no initial save; Fort DC 15 + Cha mod after 24 hrs or permanent level drain).

5.name: Word of Unmaking
5.summary: Full-round touch on corpse (100 XP), Truespeak check: slain creature cannot be raised or animated except by ritual of renaming + resurrection together.

effects.text: Syllables of Unmaking (Sp): 60 ft. range, Truespeak check vs target (15 + 2*CR + 2*uses_today), CL = character level.

classes.shortDescription: 5-level Truename PrC (ToM pp. 208-210, Table 3-5); wields the 5 Syllables and Word of Unmaking via Truespeak checks.
classes.description: Bereft (Tome of Magic pp. 208-210). Entry: Alignment Any neutral (LN, TN, CN, NG, NE), Truespeak 13 ranks, speak at least three languages, subject of ritual of renaming (3,700 gp). Grants Obscure Personal Truename at 1st and all 5 Syllables + Word of Unmaking.

classes.name: Brimstone Speaker

prerequisites.text: Special: Ability to cast true prayer of the chosen (ToM p.259)
Special: Worshiper of a deity providing access to the Fire or Good domain

1.name: Tongue of Fire 3d6
